**Videola** — a video editor that runs in a browser.
Import footage, cut it on a timeline, keyframe anything, grade it against real scopes, mix the sound to a loudness target and export an MP4. The project model, the command bus and the file format live in a Rust core compiled to WebAssembly, and nothing is uploaded anywhere: the machine running the container is the machine doing the work.
Also in it: templates that bake into ordinary editable projects, motion blur averaged over eight real instants of a shutter, spectral noise reduction, 5.1 surround with a position per track, scene detection, an HTTP API and an MCP server for AI agents.
A token is required. Every /api call carries it as an Authorization: Bearer header, and the server refuses to listen on a reachable address without one.
Support: https://github.com/fgilde/videola/issues
